groupHelp.history: Tables named after the type (Player, Club, …) hold the CURRENT state: the data of the latest imported save. When you import a newer save, rows that change (e.g. a player who improves) or disappear are moved here: <Type>_history holds only the earlier versions, <Type>_all joins current and earlier ones (useful for progression over time). _valid_from and _valid_to are imports (see the career's import history).
groupHelp.reference: Names saves do not contain (competitions, nations, cities), from the reference database you maintain.
groupHelp.derived: Helper views made by the app, e.g. nation_names (nations with their reference name).

kindHelp.entity: Current state: one row per item (e.g. a player) as it is in the latest imported save. Earlier versions are in <Type>_history.
kindHelp.event: Accumulated events: matches, injuries, completed seasons' statistics… Each save keeps only part of them; here every one seen in the imports adds up, without duplicates.
kindHelp.snapshot: Copy from the latest import (e.g. league tables at that date). Copies from earlier imports are in <Type>_history.
kindHelp.latest: Only the latest import's data (completed seasons are already in PlayerSeasonHistory).
kindHelp.child: Nested record: each row belongs to a record of another table (_parent_table), linked by _parent_rid = <parent>._rid.
kindHelp.history: Earlier versions (_history) or current + earlier (_all). _valid_to is the import that replaced the version.

query.builderHint: Added tables are linked automatically when a relation exists. Drag from a table's right dot to another table's left dot to link them by hand; click a link to edit it.

query.truncated: result truncated: use Export to get every row
query.leftJoin: Keep all rows on the left (LEFT)
